policy: 8BALL is the fixer product first. ENDSTATE is its reusable engine. A checked subpart is scoped verification, not merger, release, deployment or universal model quality.

EV-APP.result: Recorded 221 pytest checks and native application journeys passed; exact scope in validation record.

EV-HEAD.result: Delivery-head application CI passed. Not model-quality or production approval.

EV-UI.result: 51 V0.2 native checks, 17 views at desktop/mobile widths; rules/catalogue proposals, not live model quality.

EV-V01.result: Original scope: 86 pytest and 27 native browser checks. Local alpha, not a public service.

EV-QWEN.result: Three extraction fixtures structurally valid; novel supplier graph rejected because final verification action was absent. Full graph gate failed.

EV-CLASSIFIER.result: Initial GLiClass configuration: 6/30 raw top-one labels, 100% abstention. Not production-approved.

EV-REMAINING.result: Recorded guided-editor, source-handling, model-quality and production work remains.

EV-SECURITY.result: Agency identity, vault, authorisation, revocation and recovery design; no provisioned services.

EV-DECISION.result: User selected ENDSTATE; 8BALL remains the fixer application and reusable engine development supports it.

EV-ORIGINAL.result: Exact original 37-section PRD preserved, not replaced by an abbreviated status index.

EV-TRACKING.result: Documentation-only verification recorded in this session checkpoint. Not proof of a runtime feature.

milestones.title: Naming, PRD and shared delivery control

tasks.title: Lock ENDSTATE name and fixer-first product boundary
tasks.acceptance: Accepted decision distinguishes 8BALL product, ENDSTATE engine and future applications.
tasks.next_action: Preserve this decision in future work.

tasks.title: Fold the agreed direction into PRD and preserve the original
tasks.acceptance: Master PRD incorporates naming, reuse, living plans and unchanged original acceptance requirements. Original blob hash matches.
tasks.next_action: Use repository references instead of expecting chat access.

tasks.title: Create one evidence-linked version/subpart tracker for chat and Codex
tasks.acceptance: Ledger validates; generated checklist is current; regression checks reject unsupported completion and broken IDs.
tasks.next_action: Use this ledger and session protocol in both chat and Codex; keep the generated checklist in sync.

tasks.title: Evidence-backed local planner and outcome semantics
tasks.acceptance: Original bounded planner, supported-state distinctions and completion/effect separation satisfy the scoped alpha tests.
tasks.next_action: Preserve this behaviour through ENDSTATE extraction.

tasks.title: Local workspace, persistence, scenarios and exports
tasks.acceptance: Original local browser workflow persists cases and exports actual audit records with isolated scenarios.
tasks.next_action: Keep the legacy UI/data path available or migrate with verified lineage.

tasks.title: Reproducible alpha acceptance evidence
tasks.acceptance: Original 86 backend and 27 native browser results are recorded with exact code scope.
tasks.next_action: Merge/release only through a separate explicit decision.

tasks.title: Rich typed situation model and evidence provenance
tasks.acceptance: Case-scoped object IDs, source references, claims/observations and preserved historical meanings pass current tests.
tasks.next_action: Do not change observed meanings during extraction.

tasks.title: Human proposal review, accept/edit/reject and stale-state protection
tasks.acceptance: Review commits selected objects atomically; no privileged facts are created; rejected/stale proposals preserve live state.
tasks.next_action: Retain identical review guarantees for real model outputs.

tasks.title: Signed AND/OR planner, guards, waits and resource estimates
tasks.acceptance: Bounded planning exposes evidence gaps, false/unknown distinctions, projected conflicts, decision incompatibilities and scheduling limits.
tasks.next_action: Benchmark meaningful planning extensions without claiming global optimality.

tasks.title: Actors, relationships, timeline and decision records
tasks.acceptance: Reported attributes and case decisions are represented and accessible in tested operator views. No autonomous profiling is claimed.
tasks.next_action: Add authority/source-quality review in the model-quality work.

tasks.title: Questions, What Changed and isolated What If
tasks.acceptance: Graph-impact questions and recorded revision deltas operate; hypothetical state changes leave the live case unchanged.
tasks.next_action: Connect future ingestion only through reviewed revisioned updates.

tasks.title: Approvals, completion/effect separation, audit and legacy import
tasks.acceptance: Expiring approvals, protected decisions/answers, snapshot replay and lineage-preserving import satisfy current checks.
tasks.next_action: Do not confuse local hash-chain integrity with production custody.

tasks.title: Seventeen-view local developer workspace
tasks.acceptance: Listed desktop/mobile journeys pass with real server, SQLite, native storage and downloads.
tasks.next_action: Keep full accessibility and new model journeys as separate unchecked tasks.

tasks.title: Explicit playbook registry, case-local search and brief exports
tasks.acceptance: Eight labelled starter playbooks, lexical case search and operator-only brief exports work within the documented local scope.
tasks.next_action: Obtain expert playbook approval in B04-01; do not claim secure client accounts.

tasks.title: Reliable reviewed graph proposals for new situations
tasks.acceptance: Actual-model graph fixtures pass with all referenced actions present, meaningful alternative paths and explicit final verification. No silent template substitution.
blockers: Latest actual Qwen graph names an absent final verification action.
tasks.next_action: Reproduce the rejected graph, evaluate a constrained multi-stage compiler/provider, and rerun the unchanged gate.

tasks.title: Robust source extraction, deadlines and entity reconciliation
tasks.acceptance: Reviewed multi-source extraction preserves negation, uncertainty, identity and quoted support; date changes become explicit reviewed scheduling proposals.
blockers: Only a few structural extraction fixtures observed; dates need operator resolution.
tasks.next_action: Add independent cases for repeated entities, pronouns, contradictions and time resolution.

tasks.title: Independent quality evaluation and production-model selection
tasks.acceptance: Expert-labelled held-out data and predeclared acceptance thresholds measure semantic errors, omissions, corrections, latency and abstention.
tasks.next_action: Freeze evaluation criteria before choosing or tuning a production model.

tasks.title: Full twenty-step real-model V0.2 acceptance journey
tasks.acceptance: Blank case -> real extraction -> mixed human review -> valid graph -> distinct routes -> new evidence/replan -> isolated refusal -> approval/completion -> reload/export, all native.
blockers: Graph generation fails the required gate; current native journeys use rules/catalogue.
tasks.next_action: Add a real-model integration journey distinct from rules/catalogue browser tests.

tasks.title: Guided nested graph authoring instead of JSON-only advanced editing
tasks.acceptance: Operators can edit AND/OR, guards, contingencies and verification rules with guided controls and keyboard access.
tasks.next_action: Design focused authoring flows while preserving the JSON compatibility path.

tasks.title: Source chunking, duplication and reviewer-safe object reconciliation
tasks.acceptance: Longer sources retain exact provenance; duplicates and entity merges cannot rewrite observed meanings or lose attribution.
tasks.next_action: Define chunk/source version contracts and adversarial fixtures.

tasks.title: Model progress/cancellation and accurate installation status
tasks.acceptance: The UI reports actual runtime/weights/credential state and cancels work without stale commits. No silent large model download.
tasks.next_action: Add explicit opt-in setup and availability/cancellation checks, not a fictional green badge.

tasks.title: Complete accessibility and supported-environment validation
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard, screen reader, empty/error/loading states and supported browsers/platform startup paths pass an explicit review.
tasks.next_action: Audit beyond existing viewport fit and Chromium interactions.

tasks.title: Prove compatibility after ENDSTATE core extraction
tasks.acceptance: Existing 8BALL cases, imports, approvals, audits, simulations and browser flows pass through the extracted core.
tasks.next_action: Run all legacy/V2 suites against the actual new dependency boundary.

tasks.title: V0.2 acceptance and release decision
tasks.acceptance: All required V0.2 subparts have scoped evidence; reviews/gates pass; approval to integrate/release is recorded separately.
blockers: Real-model journey and developer-quality work remain unaccepted.
tasks.next_action: Keep PR #2 draft until the acceptance gate is met; do not infer permission to merge.

tasks.title: Identity, organisations and matter-scoped authorisation
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated identities and cross-tenant/matter denial tests cover read, write, export, search and model inference.
tasks.next_action: Implement from the approved production threat model.

tasks.title: Encrypted evidence vault and retention controls
tasks.acceptance: Immutable originals, hashes, upload quarantine/scanning, encryption, retention/hold/deletion and audited access are tested.
tasks.next_action: Implement without weakening source provenance.

tasks.title: Scoped specialist collaboration and real client portal
tasks.acceptance: Experts receive revocable matter/object grants; clients receive separately reviewed projections, never internal records by default.
tasks.next_action: Build authenticated views rather than relabelling the existing preview.

tasks.title: Authorised ingestion, event handling and notifications
tasks.acceptance: Actual source connectors, durable updates and notifications respect permissions, source review, ordering and retry limits.
tasks.next_action: Build one authorised connector through ENDSTATE event contracts.

tasks.title: Independent audit checkpoints, recovery and operational monitoring
tasks.acceptance: Restore rehearsal, audit anchoring, revocation and operational incident tests pass without sensitive log leakage.
tasks.next_action: Set measurable service/recovery targets and test them.

tasks.title: Limited qualified-fixer pilot acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Authorised pilot users validate usefulness, safety, corrections and confidentiality; critical findings closed before wider release.
tasks.next_action: Recruit/review pilot criteria only after data and access gates pass.

tasks.title: Professionally reviewed fixer and crisis playbooks
tasks.acceptance: Specialists approve versioned patterns, assumptions, authority and confirmation criteria; examples are not presented as proven solutions.
tasks.next_action: Review existing starters with qualified operators.

tasks.title: Governed precedent retrieval
tasks.acceptance: Permissioned, source-linked precedent is case/matter scoped; access revocation and leakage tests pass. No automatic training.
tasks.next_action: Agree governance and retention before indexing previous cases.

tasks.title: Measured operator benefit from richer resolution intelligence
tasks.acceptance: Held-out/pilot evidence shows useful questions and plans without unsupported causal or success-probability claims.
tasks.next_action: Benchmark against the accepted baseline with real professional review.

tasks.title: Commercial onboarding, support and launch readiness
tasks.acceptance: Customer onboarding, support, service terms, brand/licence clearance and operating ownership are ready for the accepted scope.
tasks.next_action: Define commercial acceptance with the product owner; no inferred public release.

tasks.title: 8BALL V1 fixer production release
tasks.acceptance: All advertised capabilities, security, accessibility, recovery, model policy and customer acceptance are evidenced for supported environments.
tasks.next_action: Record explicit release and deployment decisions after gates.

tasks.title: Define ENDSTATE contracts and dependency boundary
tasks.acceptance: Neutral engine inputs/outputs, version/error semantics and product/domain boundaries are documented with tests planned.
tasks.next_action: Map existing eightball/v2 contracts and avoid a naming-only directory rewrite.

tasks.title: Extract shared state, planning and explanation kernel
tasks.acceptance: 8BALL calls the extracted core; the core imports no 8BALL UI, named client or fixer playbook.
tasks.next_action: Extract incrementally, retaining compatibility adapters.

tasks.title: Preserve storage, imports and audit lineage
tasks.acceptance: Old data, imports and event meanings remain readable; migrations preserve observations and expiring approval behaviour.
tasks.next_action: Add compatibility fixtures before moving persistence boundaries.

tasks.title: Prove reuse through neutral, sales and support fixtures
tasks.acceptance: One unchanged kernel plans three domains with domain-specific actions/policies; no duplicated engine or full new app.
tasks.next_action: Create small fictional contract tests, including opt-out and remedy-authority restrictions.

tasks.title: Reusable core acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Current 8BALL suites and cross-domain fixtures pass on the proposed shared package; version compatibility is explicit.
tasks.next_action: Accept extracted package only with exact regression evidence.

tasks.title: Normalised event and authority contract
tasks.acceptance: Events carry source, version, occurrence/receipt time, matter scope and review status; incoming text never gets command authority.
tasks.next_action: Define the observe/propose/review/commit/replan boundary.

tasks.title: Durable ordered updates, idempotency and replay
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate, delayed, reordered and retried events cannot corrupt state or revive expired permissions.
tasks.next_action: Implement event/outbox contracts and fault-injection tests.

tasks.title: Reviewed graph amendments and affected-route explanations
tasks.acceptance: New information can propose a graph/dependency change, but cannot remove restrictions until reviewed at the correct revision.
tasks.next_action: Separate observed fact updates from catalogue/graph amendments.

tasks.title: Freshness, cancellation and performance evidence
tasks.acceptance: Measured latencies include ingestion, inference and review; incremental replan results match full recomputation; cancelled/stale work cannot commit.
tasks.next_action: Define target workloads and latency budgets before a real-time claim.

tasks.title: Provider-independent reviewed outcome compiler
tasks.acceptance: Source interpretation, typed graph drafting and deterministic validation are clean interchangeable interfaces outside the product layer.
tasks.next_action: Evolve existing adapters into ENDSTATE contracts without losing raw output/provenance.

tasks.title: Shared real-model semantic acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Use B02-09/B02-11/B02-12 evidence for a valid, useful source-to-plan route, not just JSON or an HTTP response.
blockers: Failed real graph generation; no independent quality approval.
tasks.next_action: Resolve the 8BALL gate once and link the same evidence here.

tasks.title: Optional Jev live judgement integration
tasks.acceptance: An authorised real TypeSafe key exercises bounded classifications; permission, output and quality checks are recorded with secrets excluded.
blockers: No authorised TypeSafe credentials supplied for live evaluation.
tasks.next_action: Configure through a secure runtime secret mechanism only when authorised.

tasks.title: Local-model installation and live provider status
tasks.acceptance: Runtime, selected weights, version and connection status are actually detected; downloads are explicit and user-approved.
tasks.next_action: Distinguish installed weights, running service, API credentials and test-run artefacts.

tasks.title: Failure handling, model trace and governed provider selection
tasks.acceptance: Provider replacement, refusal, timeout, malformed output, prompt injection and trace retention satisfy shared gates with measured quality.
tasks.next_action: Extend existing fail-closed tests and preserve negative model results.

tasks.title: Versioned domain-pack contract
tasks.acceptance: Domain packs supply vocabulary, object mappings, action catalogues, policies, confirmation rules, prompts and integrations without core forks.
tasks.next_action: Derive the contract from 8BALL and adjacent fixtures.

tasks.title: 8BALL domain pack on ENDSTATE
tasks.acceptance: Fixer terminology/playbooks/experience are product-owned and use the shared contracts; existing routes/data remain compatible.
tasks.next_action: Separate domain responsibilities only where real code supports the boundary.

tasks.title: Adjacent-domain proof and commercial-lane gate
tasks.acceptance: Sales/support examples run on the same engine with their own evaluation/permissions; new product launches need explicit approval.
tasks.next_action: Demonstrate reuse before considering sales, service or social-client products.

tasks.title: Decide and validate distribution interface
tasks.acceptance: SDK/API/MCP options have a justified scope, auth/version contracts and consumer tests; do not declare all three products shipped.
tasks.next_action: Choose the smallest actual integration need with the owner.

tasks.title: Compatibility, performance, licensing and support policy
tasks.acceptance: Supported engine consumers, migrations, limits, licences and operational ownership are documented and exercised.
tasks.next_action: Validate against real product/consumer requirements.

tasks.title: ENDSTATE V1 release gate
tasks.acceptance: Reusable contracts and quality/support promises have evidence; independent release approval is recorded.
tasks.next_action: Do not block accepted 8BALL sales solely on a standalone-engine release.

invariants: Evidence, claims and observations are separate.
Unknown is not false; disputes are explicit.
Completing work does not establish its result.
Simulations never mutate live case state.
No secret/model weights/private case material in this public repo.
No model-quality claim from a code-contract test.
Do not merge or deploy without explicit release authority.
